mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS step_id, s.card_id AS card_id, s.kind, s.answer::text AS answer_json, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.content -> 'options') = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(s.content -> 'options') ELSE 0 END AS option_count, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.content -> 'concept_ids') = 'array' THEN s.content -> 'concept_ids' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)) AS concept_ids FROM steps s JOIN cards c ON c.id = s.card_id WHERE s.id = #{stepId} AND c.status IN ('published', 'pending')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN #{stepId} = (SELECT s.id FROM steps s WHERE s.card_id = #{cardId} AND s.kind <> 'concept' ORDER BY s.step_no LIMIT 1) THEN MAX(ua.attempt_no) + 1 ELSE MAX(ua.attempt_no) END FROM user_answers ua WHERE ua.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND ua.card_id = #{cardId}), 1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_answers (user_id, card_id, step_id, answer, is_correct, graded_by, confidence, response_ms, answer_changes, attempt_no) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid), #{cardId}, #{stepId}, CAST(#{answerJson} AS jsonb), #{isCorrect}, 'code', #{confidence, jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{responseMs, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{answerChanges, jdbcType=INTEGER}, )
